notes.title: GRUEL 1.1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Gruelers![/h2][p]
Welcome to [b]Sloptember[/b], a month packed with a couple of fun events coming your way! This patch is our “Clean-Up Day” update, aimed at smoothing out rough edges, fixing a few pesky issues, and adding some neat new features. We hope these changes make Gruel even more enjoyable while we cook up the upcoming event later this month. [/p][p][/p][p]Now, on to the patch notes:  [/p][list][*][p] Added two new shield items to the shop.  [/p][/*][*][p] Added popup messages to notify you of new journal entries and certain events.  [/p][/*][*][p] Added a new room.[/p][/*][*][p] Skeletons now have a new idle sound, making them easier to recognize.  [/p][/*][*][p] Battle music has been adjusted so that only 2 songs play at once instead of 4. This should help players with music issues and improve performance.  [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a framerate-related issue with the Leadhound.  [/p][/*][*][p] The Vampirism seal effect has been increased by 2.5x.  [/p][/*][*][p] The "Almost a Billionaire" achievement now requires 100,000 gold instead of 1,000,000 gold.  [/p][/*][*][p] A weight icon is now shown for heavy guns in the second slot.  [/p][/*][*][p] The game now remembers if you have disabled the supporter pack.  [/p][/*][*][p] The journal now shows exclamation marks for entries you haven’t seen yet.  
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Gruel away![/p]

Added popup messages to notify you of new journal entries and certain events.
Added a new room.
Skeletons now have a new idle sound, making them easier to recognize.

notes.title: GRUEL 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Gruelers![/h2][p]
We have been slowly starting up again after taking a little break of GRUEL. This patch includes a few fixes, a new weapon, and my own pain and suffering!
[/p][list][*][p]Added a new weapon: [spoiler]the Junker[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]The Eel now feels more slippery, like it should be.[/p][/*][*][p]Tried to fix a weird crash multiple people had. [/p][/*][*][p]Made the Waste seal not able to drop melee weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Set up some internal files for a future update. Nothing to see here... yet.
[/p][/*][/list]
Thanks as always for playing GRUEL. More smaller updates are coming soon. Stay GRUELING.

tags.feature: Added a new weapon: [spoiler]the Junker[/spoiler]

tags.balance_change: The Eel now feels more slippery, like it should be.

tags.bug: Tried to fix a weird crash multiple people had.
Made the Waste seal not able to drop melee weapons.

notes.title: THE ILLEGAL UPDATE IS HERE (1.1.0)
notes.content:
[p]It's been too long since the last update. Technically? That's a crime. Let’s break some rules!
[/p][p]This was supposed to be a small update. Just a little patch. A quick crime. But then we started adding things. Fixing things. Suddenly we were deep in seal rituals, animation tweaks, ammo math, and moral compromises.[/p][p]What you’re getting now is a chunkier, nastier, more complete version of GRUEL. A more [i]whole[/i] package, if you will.[/p][p]Also, there are now more ways to spend your hard-earned (and questionably acquired) currency. We’re very proud of that. 
[/p][p][i]Note: With all these changes, the scoreboards have been reset for version 1.1.0. Your old scores are now part of the historical record, or evidence, depending on who’s asking.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][h3]New Stuff[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]3[/b] new enemies. Suspicious characters. Highly questionable behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]6[/b] new seals. What do they do? Illegal things.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]10[/b] new weapons. Too many? That’s none of your business.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the journal?[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b][i]REDACTED[/i][/b] location[/p][/*][*][p]New Damage Numbers setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Breaking a weapon now triggers a tiny hand animation. Because crime should have style. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Heavy weapons now slow you down when carried. Seems fair. It's not.[/p][/*][*][p]Howitzer max ammo increased to 38 (was 20). It’s also heavy now. You’ve been warned.[/p][/*][*][p]Prismbow ammo increased to 14 (was 10). Load up.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghost of Greed now spawns with less gold. Greed isn't what it used to be.[/p][/*][*][p]Rage effect now lasts twice as long. We're not calming down.[/p][/*][*][p]Chilli sauce actually makes sure a cursed enemy spawns every level.[/p][/*][*][p]Tar sauce slowness now takes half a second instead of a quarter second.[/p][/*][*][p]Rocketlauncher now actually reloads. Revolutionary concept.[/p][/*][*][p]Brick now deals 30 damage (was 20). It’s just a brick. That hits very hard.[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed enemies now show up from Level 3 (was 6) with Chilli sauce. Early terror.[/p][/*][*][p]Skeletons shoot with 2 more animation frames now. Easier to dodge. Maybe.[/p][/*][*][p]Hotblood seal damage bonus lowered to +20% per level (was 40%). You guys were too powerful.[/p][/*][*][p]Waste seal now checks enemy value before dropping weapons. Amo drops less for example. That's life.[/p][/*][*][p]Biters now pause briefly before attacking. One-third of a second of mercy.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sidekick limit of 2 on each room. Making it so only two types of sidekick enemies (Jellyfish, Ghoul, etc) can spawn in a single room.
After clearing a room, pickups now suck themselves into your criminal pockets faster. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Rattler stuttering when out of ammo. Rattle restored.[/p][/*][*][p]Knockback now scales smoothly with framerate. No more jank physics justice.[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamite is now framerate-independent. It’s always dynamite time.[/p][/*][*][p]Handheld turret can now be thrown mid-fire. Sounds dangerous. It is.[/p][/*][*][p]Turrets thrown into another plane now behave properly and don’t vanish. They know where they belong.[/p][/*][*][p]There's probably more but I forgot.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s it for now. We’ll be watching to see what kind of illegal nonsense you get up to with all this new stuff.[/p][p]Go break the rules. Break your weapons. Break the economy.[/p][p]We’ll see you in the next one (unless this update gets us shut down).[/p]

tags.feature: Added [b]3[/b] new enemies. Suspicious characters. Highly questionable behavior.
Added [b]6[/b] new seals. What do they do? Illegal things.
Added [b]10[/b] new weapons. Too many? That’s none of your business.
Added the journal?
Added [b][i]REDACTED[/i][/b] location
New Damage Numbers setting.
Breaking a weapon now triggers a tiny hand animation. Because crime should have style.

tags.balance_change: Heavy weapons now slow you down when carried. Seems fair. It's not.
Howitzer max ammo increased to 38 (was 20). It’s also heavy now. You’ve been warned.
Prismbow ammo increased to 14 (was 10). Load up.
Ghost of Greed now spawns with less gold. Greed isn't what it used to be.
Rage effect now lasts twice as long. We're not calming down.
Chilli sauce actually makes sure a cursed enemy spawns every level.
Tar sauce slowness now takes half a second instead of a quarter second.
Rocketlauncher now actually reloads. Revolutionary concept.
Brick now deals 30 damage (was 20). It’s just a brick. That hits very hard.
Cursed enemies now show up from Level 3 (was 6) with Chilli sauce. Early terror.
Skeletons shoot with 2 more animation frames now. Easier to dodge. Maybe.
Hotblood seal damage bonus lowered to +20% per level (was 40%). You guys were too powerful.
Waste seal now checks enemy value before dropping weapons. Amo drops less for example. That's life.
Biters now pause briefly before attacking. One-third of a second of mercy.
Added a sidekick limit of 2 on each room. Making it so only two types of sidekick enemies (Jellyfish, Ghoul, etc) can spawn in a single room.
After clearing a room, pickups now suck themselves into your criminal pockets faster.

tags.bug: Fixed Rattler stuttering when out of ammo. Rattle restored.
Knockback now scales smoothly with framerate. No more jank physics justice.
Dynamite is now framerate-independent. It’s always dynamite time.
Handheld turret can now be thrown mid-fire. Sounds dangerous. It is.
Turrets thrown into another plane now behave properly and don’t vanish. They know where they belong.

notes.title: GRUEL 1.0.2: April Fish?!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Gruelers![/h2]

You just got April Fished! Because the dungeon just got a flopping make-over! We have a special leaderboard for this event. Play with a new seal, and increased fish weaponry chances!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new seal.
[*] Changed sounds for Enchanted Lamia's.
[*] Changed critical hit sound for Leadhound.
[*] Changed the way weapons get randomly spawned.
[*] Changed how bullets behave touching enemies that cannot take damage.
[*] Added a setting to toggle special events.
[*] Added April Fish!
[/list]

Go and gruel it out!

tags.feature: Added a new seal.
Added a setting to toggle special events.
Added April Fish!

notes.title: GRUEL 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Gruelers![/h2]

While we are working hard on the first content update, I wanted to get some quality of life changes your way as soon as possible!

[h2]Changelog![/h2]
[list]
[*] The game can now be ran on a higher framerate in the settings.
[*] Reworked attacks of Amoeba, Spidercrabs and Enchanted Lamia's.
[*] When doing a run with sauces, it now shows what sauces you've used.
[*] Entering a new level will now show the location name aswell as what level you are at.
[*] Pressing the kick button on the gameover screen now skips the score counting completely.
[*] And some other small bugfixes.
[/list]

See you in a Gruel!

notes.title: GRUEL demo 0.25.2
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Gruelers![/h2]

Before we change the future of GRUEL with the release, we wanted to update the demo to fix crucial bugs and make sure we are ready for release!

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Big pickups now don't dissapear
[*] Increased likelihood of Flea markets spawning
[*] Gruel room now has an entering sound

[*] Deflecting a bullet with the mighty legs seal now aims the bullet towards where you look
[*] Shadewalkers now shoot multiple shade-bullets
[*] Leadhounds now slightly show when you do more damage to them

[*] Controllers now have analog movement support
[*] A confirmation now pops up when quitting the game
[/list]

Happy Grueling!

notes.title: GRUEL demo 0.25.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Gruelers![/h2]

Thank you all for the amazing responses to the demo! It has been incredible to see! Your feedback has helped us tremendously, and we are hard at work bringing you the full version of GRUEL! But until then, we've brought you a little update.

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added two new seals  
[*] Added four new rooms  
[*] A special icon now appears on the main menu when you reach the Gruel Room  
[*] Killing an enemy with a kick now doubles the chance of pickups  

[*] Improved turret mechanics and collision detection  
[*] Turrets now have additional sound effects  
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause turrets to randomly crash the game  
[*] Reduced damage from homing bullets  
[*] Made Amoebs easier to hit  
[*] Coffinboy's skeleton wave no longer passes through walls  
[*] Enhanced bullet casing sprites  

[*] The game now pauses when a controller disconnects  
[*] Fixed issues with the tutorial settings menu  
[*] Added an option to invert Y-axis camera movement  
[/list]

Happy Grueling!
